self_caught_defect_in_my_own_new_script.what: scripts/audits/verify-a30-mcp-memory-reclamation.sh (new this tick) emitted INVALID JSON on its first real run: '"min_pct": 87,00'.
self_caught_defect_in_my_own_new_script.cause: French locale. awk did two things silently: parsed '95.20'+0 as 95 (stops at '.', not its decimal separator), and printed %.2f as '95,00'. So every computed min/max was truncated AND the output was unparseable — while still looking like plausible numbers.
self_caught_defect_in_my_own_new_script.caught_by: Every emitted value ending in ,00 across a sample set that visibly had decimals. The verdict (FOLD) was unaffected because the dip count and tripwire comparisons survived truncation.
self_caught_defect_in_my_own_new_script.fixed: LC_ALL=C / LC_NUMERIC=C pinned at the top with a do-not-remove comment. Regression-tested: 3-probe run now emits valid JSON with real decimals (88.14 / 88.58).
self_caught_defect_in_my_own_new_script.class: Same family as the BSD `date %3N` literal corruption already recorded — platform/locale formatting silently corrupting machine-readable output.
